label: Seedream 4.5 / 5 — Bild

must: Natural language. Build the content from subject + action + environment, then add short words for style, colour, lighting and composition.
Be concrete instead of abstract: 'a woman in a linen dress walking a tree-lined avenue, Monet oil painting style' beats 'woman, street, painterly'.
Name explicit anatomy directly and plainly when it is part of the scene. Short declarative sentences work better here than elaborate phrasing.
End with the shot size when it matters: 'Full-body shot.', 'Close-up.'
Any text that must appear in the image goes in quotation marks.
With several reference images, say which image supplies which element.
avoid: Negative prompt syntax — this system has no negative prompt.
Style words standing alone without a subject.
Scale or proportion clauses when no person is in the scene - they only apply to people.

preferred_terms: realistic human proportions relative to the surrounding objects
notes_for_model: Seedream follows short, concrete, declarative sentences better than long flowing prose. It renders quoted text well and reads editing instructions in the form Action + Object + Attribute, for example 'replace the jacket with a red leather one'. Keep style descriptors short and attached to a concrete subject.
